summary: Manchester United were eliminated from the Champions League at the group stage after a 1-0 home defeat to Bayern Munich, finishing bottom of their group and dropping out of Europe altogether. The report describes a flat, low-energy performance at Old Trafford, with Kingsley Coman scoring the winner on 71 minutes after a Harry Kane assist. It raises growing questions about Erik ten Hag and Andre Onana, and frames the exit as part of a decade of disappointment in the competition.
one_line: Manchester United crashed out of the Champions League group stage, bottom of the group, after a listless 1-0 home loss to Bayern Munich.
key_facts: Manchester United lost 1-0 at home to Bayern Munich at Old Trafford, ending their Champions League campaign.
United finished bottom of their group and are out of Europe altogether, with no Europa League place.
It is the third time United have gone out at the group stage since Sir Alex Ferguson, making it their most common round of exit in that period.
Copenhagen took the second place United had aimed for, despite having a fraction of United's budget.
Copenhagen's victory over Galatasaray meant that any United win would have been irrelevant.
Kingsley Coman scored the winning goal on 71 minutes after Harry Kane clipped an artful ball back through for him.
Bayern were already through and had lost 5-1 to Eintracht Frankfurt in their previous game.
Lukas Lerager scored for Copenhagen shortly before the hour, with the news reaching Old Trafford during the match.
Bruno Fernandes blazed United's best chance over the bar after good work from Aaron Wan Bissaka.
The Stretford End implored United to "attack attack attack", but some of the stadium booed the side off at the end.
The article questions why Andre Onana stayed so close to his line for the goal, calling his season strange; he was Ten Hag's primary signing.
Harry Kane, long billed as a potential United player, did not score but set up the winner, and plays for Bayern rather than an English club.
The report describes the exit as part of a decade of disappointment for United in the competition.
